action_summary: Restored the five-fold BERT ensemble that scored 0.36763 in v21 (v22 dropped to 0.35115 by using fold4 alone). Folds are now loaded in a loop, run one at a time and freed to limit GPU memory, with missing checkpoint directories skipped gracefully. Because the metric is Spearman (rank-based), the fold predictions are combined as a 50/50 blend of the mean sigmoid probability and the mean per-column normalized rank, so no fold with a different output scale dominates; the result is clipped to [0,1]. Also moved tokenizer construction out of the per-example loop for speed. Submission format and Kaggle paths are unchanged.
